comments.author: jero
comments.body_html:
Hey! When I released AmmoBox1x1 back on October 26th, there weren’t any SPT 4.0 mods that changed ammo box colors yet. If you mean ODT’s Item Info, that one only came out on November 8th.

I’ll probably remove this feature at some point when I have more free time and just let other mods deal with it. No big rush though — it’s not breaking anything.

comments.author: Brin
comments.body_html:
Tyfon’s UI Fixes mod has that.

It allows you to set a hotkey to open ammo boxes (default = U). If you click & drag to select multiple boxes and then hit that hotkey, it’ll unpack all of them.
